A heavy freight trailer sits silhouetted in the shadows, disconnected from the safety of the facility. Long-exposure calm, atmospheric fog rolling in, no moving figures, highlighting the quiet vulnerability of a freight pickup point. Clean geometry, cinematic lighting, sophisticated color palette, wide anamorphic composition.
